title: How 622 DAYS Changed EVERYTHING About Deshaun Watson's $230M Browns Comeback
description:
Deshaun Watson returns to football after 622 days, two Achilles surgeries, and a $230 million contract that has handcuffed the Cleveland Browns. This is the story of the most expensive comeback attempt in NFL history, the rookie threatening to make it irrelevant, and a franchise desperate to escape quarterback purgatory. Watson starts Saturday's preseason opener in Chicago. Shedeur Sanders waits in the wings. And the Browns' future hangs in the balance of a decision that should have been made years ago.
